sourceOfTruth.tokensAndComponentClasses: project-template-design-html/theme.css; the <style> block inlined in 337 of 337 canonical screen files is identical to it.
sourceOfTruth.exports: email-pages/ (111) and project-template-design-html/ (458) are generated exports: counted once, never as additional references. Every export screen has a canonical equivalent with identical visible text (role + canonicalEquivalent below).
